report:
test_total does not fail. It passes. The failing test is test_half_cent_rounds_up.

I ran the three tests in test_cart.py (pytest is not installed, so I called each test function directly):

  test_plain                PASS
  test_total                PASS
  test_half_cent_rounds_up  FAIL

Why test_total passes: 399 * (1 - 10/100) = 399 * 0.9 = 359.1 as a float, and int(359.1) is 359, which is the expected value. Truncation and rounding give the same answer here, so the bug in cart.total is hidden.

Why test_half_cent_rounds_up fails: 1010 * 0.95 = 959.5. cart.total uses int(), which truncates toward zero, giving 959. The test expects 960 (half cent rounds up). The docstring says "rounded to whole cents", but int() truncates instead of rounding. That is the cause.

No files were changed. cart.py is as it was.
